checks.title: API tokens
checks.detail: listening on the network without any token: anyone who reaches the port writes and reads
checks.fix: set TRACEREPORTS_TOKEN and TRACEREPORTS_INGEST_TOKEN (openssl rand -hex 32), or listen only on 127.0.0.1

checks.title: UI login
checks.detail: no UI login: a token does not protect reads, and the Host check is not access control
checks.fix: set TRACEREPORTS_UI_USER and TRACEREPORTS_UI_PASSWORD (and HTTPS on the proxy)

checks.title: Network exposure
checks.detail: TRACEREPORTS_INSECURE=1: the server listens on the network even without credentials
checks.fix: remove TRACEREPORTS_INSECURE and set the tokens and the UI login

checks.title: AI provider
checks.detail: local rules engine or off: no evidence leaves the server

checks.title: Settings locked
checks.detail: any admin (and every UI user) can change the AI provider, its URL and key from the screen

checks.title: Retention
checks.fix: set TRACEREPORTS_RETENTION_DAYS to what your data policy allows

checks.title: Evidence encryption at rest
checks.detail: off: the evidence is as safe as the disk of DATA_DIR
checks.fix: set TRACEREPORTS_ENCRYPT_AT_REST=1 with TRACEREPORTS_DB_KEY_FILE, and keep DATA_DIR on an encrypted volume

checks.title: Process user
checks.fix: run as an unprivileged user (the official image already is nonroot)

checks.title: DATA_DIR permissions
checks.detail: /data is 0755: other users of the host can read the evidence

checks.title: Outbound destinations
checks.detail: none: no data leaves the server

checks.title: Secret redaction
checks.detail: secrets in headers, bodies and logs are masked before storing

checks.title: Screenshot policy
checks.detail: every screenshot, trace and video is kept
checks.fix: set TRACEREPORTS_SCREENSHOTS=failures (or off) and mask sensitive fields in the clients
